title: Witboost Skeleton Parameters
description: Schema for skeleton/parameters.yaml files. These files are AUTO-GENERATED by Witboost during template execution. They store user input and computed values as Nunjucks expressions, used later to render catalog-info.yaml at display/deploy time. Template developers include this file in the skeleton ONLY for readonly/computed values (e.g., readonly.__system__, readonly.__version__) or tech-adapter-specific values. NEVER hardcode sample data — use Nunjucks expressions like ${{ parameters.fieldName }}.

parameters.description: User input from the wizard form. AUTO-POPULATED by Witboost at execution time — do NOT add this section manually in the skeleton. Witboost fills it from the wizard form data.

values.description: Computed/derived values from the fetch:template step's input.values. For system templates, may include tech-adapter-specific values (e.g., TAbranchName). Most values are auto-populated by Witboost — only include this section if adding extra computed values not already in the step.

readonly.description: Immutable fields computed at creation time via Nunjucks expressions. For components, typically includes __system__ (parent Data Product reference) and __version__ (major version derived from identifier). Uses expressions like ${{ parameters.dataproduct }} and ${{ parameters.identifier.split('.')[2] }}.0.0.
